title: MZ Need help displaying variable with Variable Gold Display (Visustella)

posts.author: tsurugikage
posts.body:
So I am using
Visual Gold Display VisuStella MZ
and I am trying to use a variable to display an amount of gold, but the variable isn't showing as a gold amount, but as text in the text box and not as a gold value.
It does work for normal numbers, but not variables.

posts.body:

EDIT2: Not sure if that helps. EDIT3: Maybe it's not coded to accept variables.

posts.author: rpgLord69
posts.body:
You can do something like this, but if you want it to not show 0-values (EDIT: middle zeroes), you have to make the conditionals more complicated. Or you can try to check for a plugin that lets you run code in text messages and use it to draw just the numbers and icons you want.
◆Input Number：#0011, 4 digits
◆Script：$gameVariables.setValue(12, $gameVariables.value(11).toString()[0])
：      ：$gameVariables.setValue(13, $gameVariables.value(11).toString()[1])
：      ：$gameVariables.setValue(14, $gameVariables.value(11).toString()[2])
：      ：$gameVariables.setValue(15, $gameVariables.value(11).toString()[3])
◆If：#0011 ≥ 1000
◆Text：None, None, Window, Bottom
：    ：You are selling for \v[12]\I[3]\v[13]\I[2]\v[14]\I[1]\v[15]\G
◆
：Else
◆If：#0011 ≥ 100
◆Text：None, None, Window, Bottom
：    ：You are selling for \v[12]\I[2]\v[13]\I[1]\v[14]\G
◆
：Else
◆If：#0011 ≥ 10
◆Text：None, None, Window, Bottom
：    ：You are selling for \v[12]\I[1]\v[13]\G
◆
：Else
◆If：#0011 ≥ 0
◆Text：None, None, Window, Bottom
：    ：You are selling for \v[12]\G
◆
：End
◆
：End
◆
：End
◆
：End
